topic: Accurate measurement of physical quantities and data organization
key_concepts: Measurement compares an object to a standard
Quantitative observations are more useful in science
Liquid volume is measured with a beaker or graduated cylinder in liters or milliliters
Mass is measured with a weighing scale or beam balance in kilograms or grams
Length is measured with a ruler, meterstick, or tape measure in meters or centimeters
Accurate liquid volume reading uses the lower meniscus at eye level on a flat surface
Accurate length measurement aligns the zero mark and reads at eye level
Repeating measurements and getting the same value indicates accuracy
Data tables organize independent and dependent variables
Graphs place independent variable on x-axis and dependent variable on y-axis with a descri
Volume of regular solids is calculated as length x width x height in cubic centimeters
Data organization helps in interpreting results and drawing conclusions
